For \(n\geq1\), define \(K^n:C^n(Y;k)\to C^{n-1}(X;k)\) by \(K^n\varphi=\varphi\circ P_H\), and set \(K^0=0\). Evaluating the chain identity [F2] on an \(n\)-chain and using the positive coboundary convention in [F1] gives
\[
(g^*-f^*)\varphi=\delta(K^{n+1}\varphi)+K^n(\delta\varphi).
\]
For \(n=0\), the second summand is zero because \(C^{-1}=0\), and the degree-zero case of [F2] gives the same identity. [F1, F2, algebra]
